label: Remotive
terms_note: Free public API with attribution + frequency conditions; paid private API.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (search JSON). Lane `assist` → **api for search** only with a ≤ 4/day cadence. Confidence high.

endpoints.notes: jobs[]: id, url, title, company_name, category, job_type, publication_date, candidate_required_location, salary, description

reference.limits: - Link back + name Remotive; no reposting to Jooble/Google Jobs/LinkedIn; max ~4 requests/day; 24 h delay; paid private API $5k/mo. - Free public API with attribution + frequency conditions; paid private API.

search_postings.note: Keyless public API. Only limit is documented (no page parameter), so page > 1 repeats the same result set. Terms: link back to the Remotive URL and name Remotive as the source, never re-post the jobs to other job sites, and 'fetch at most ~4 times a day' (the client-side limiter allows one call per 100 s); listings are delayed 24 h. salary is a free-text string, left in raw. Mirrors jobs/remotive: category is a Remotive category name or slug (/api/remote-jobs/categories); buyer is company_name.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: No per-id endpoint is documented; the feed returns whole records.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application or bid API; the README asks to link back to the Remotive job URL.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
